title: Field monitor diagnostics filters
summary: For the site owner: Field monitor → Diagnostics in My account can now show only critical, warning or info items, and the Android widget's severity counts open that view.
items: Diagnostics has All, Critical, Warning and Info buttons, each with its count.
Links ending in #monitor-diagnostics-critical, -warning or -info open Diagnostics already filtered; the Android widget's ✕ ! i counts use them from Android 1.14.0.
Older #monitor-diagnostics links still open the full list.
